cohort: 39,118 women who underwent frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles at a tertiary-care academic medical center between January 2016 and December 2022.
finding: Embryo retention in the transfer catheter decreases the chance of biochemical pregnancy, clinical pregnancy, and live birth in FET cycles, while being associated with higher birth weight, with no observed differences in miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy, cesarean delivery, or gestational age.
mod_finding: No differences were observed in terms of cesarean delivery between the embryo retention and control groups.
